WITH target_token AS (
                SELECT
                    id,
                    user_id,
                    family_id,
                    is_revoked AS was_already_revoked
                FROM refresh_tokens
                WHERE token_hash = $1
                LIMIT 1
            ),
            update_family AS (
                UPDATE refresh_tokens
                SET is_revoked = true
                WHERE family_id = (SELECT family_id FROM target_token)
                AND is_revoked = false 
            )
            -- Return the initial state captured in the first CTE
            SELECT
                id,
                user_id,
                family_id,
                was_already_revoked
            FROM target_token;
